limitations: The result corrects the derivative of the source model's instantaneous voltage-coupling energy when conductances evolve. It does not disprove the fixed-conductance Lyapunov theorem, rule out another composite Lyapunov function, or assert that the published nominal trajectories contain an observed energy increase. Discrete hybrid events are outside the continuous-time identity.
provenance: Scientific derivation from the cited adaptive bioelectric morphogenesis model and its public implementation; review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
record_title: Exact conductance-work correction to an adaptive bioelectric Lyapunov balance
